body: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
plain_description: ComfyUI is an AI creation engine that gives creative professionals complete control over every model, parameter, and output through a visual node-graph interface. Generate images, videos, 3D models, and audio using the latest open-source AI models—all running locally on your hardware. Complex workflows can be packaged as simple apps, and production pipelines integrate via API endpoints.
technical_description: ComfyUI is a modular, graph-based AI inference engine and GUI for generative content creation. It provides a node-graph interface for composing diffusion model workflows, supporting image, video, audio, and 3D generation with models such as Stable Diffusion, Flux, Hunyuan, and Wan. The runtime features an asynchronous queue system, smart memory management with automatic GPU offloading (supports as low as 1GB VRAM), and incremental graph execution that only recomputes changed nodes. It supports safetensors and PyTorch checkpoint formats, LoRA adapters, ControlNet, and embeddings. Integration is available through REST API endpoints, and optional API nodes provide access to external paid model services.
title: ComfyUI

body: Diffusion Bee is the easiest way to run Stable Diffusion locally on your M1 Mac. Comes with a one-click installer. No dependencies or technical knowledge needed.
plain_description: The big picture: Diffusion Bee lets anyone generate professional AI images on their own Mac with zero recurring cloud costs. Here's why it matters: it runs fully offline, supports the latest Stable Diffusion models, and installs in one click with no technical skills required. The bottom line: unlimited creative control with complete privacy.
technical_description: Diffusion Bee is a macOS desktop application that wraps Stable Diffusion inference in a native GUI. Built on Electron, it provides inference backends including PyTorch (via Hugging Face Diffusers) and TensorFlow. The application supports SD 1.x, SD 2.x, SD XL, ControlNet, LoRA, inpainting, and outpainting models with text-to-image, image-to-image, AI canvas, and image upscaling workflows. All inference runs locally on Intel and Apple Silicon CPUs/GPUs with Metal Performance Shader optimization for M1/M2. Model weights are downloaded through the application interface and cached locally. No cloud infrastructure is required and no user data is transmitted externally.
title: Diffusion Bee

body: The community repository for the Draw Things app.
plain_description: Run professional AI image generation on your own infrastructure — Apple devices, Linux GPU servers, or both. No cloud dependency, no per-image fees, full control over your data and models. Also supports LoRA fine-tuning and model serving for production workflows.
technical_description: Draw Things Community is the open-source repository containing the core inference, training, and serving components of the Draw Things application. It provides re-implementations of diffusion model architectures and samplers, a gRPC server (gRPCServerCLI) for headless GPU-accelerated inference on Linux and macOS, and a CLI tool for local generation and LoRA fine-tuning. The server supports NVIDIA CUDA acceleration on Linux via Docker or bare-metal deployment, while the macOS toolchain leverages CoreML and Apple Silicon. Builds are managed with Bazel or Swift Package Manager, with pre-built binaries available for both platforms.
title: Draw Things Community

body: Official inference repo for FLUX.1 models
plain_description: Generate and edit stunning, high-quality images from text descriptions using FLUX, a leading family of AI image models from Black Forest Labs. You can create custom visuals, edit existing photos with in/out-painting, and control composition — all without a design team. The bottom line: professional-grade image generation and editing that you can run locally or access via API.
technical_description: FLUX is the official inference codebase for Black Forest Labs' FLUX.1 family of flow-matching image generation models. The Python-based pipeline supports multiple model variants including text-to-image, in/out-painting, structural conditioning (Canny edge and depth), image variation, and in-context image editing. Execution uses a Python virtual environment with optional NVIDIA TensorRT acceleration for optimized GPU inference. Models are loaded from HuggingFace as open-weight PyTorch checkpoints. The codebase also provides a CLI interface, Gradio and Streamlit demos, and integration with the BFL REST API for Pro tier model access and commercial usage tracking.
title: FLUX

plain_description: Fooocus generates professional-quality images from simple text descriptions — no complex settings or prompt engineering needed. It runs completely free and offline on your own computer, with an install that takes less than three clicks. Anyone can create beautiful visuals without a subscription or deep technical expertise.
technical_description: Fooocus is an offline, open-source image generation application built on the Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) architecture. It provides a Gradio-based web UI for text-to-image generation and supports image-to-image workflows including inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, and variation. The application incorporates an offline GPT-2-based prompt expansion engine for automatic prompt enhancement and uses custom sampling algorithms for improved output quality. It supports multiple model presets (General, Realistic, Anime), LoRA and embedding integration, ControlNet-based image prompting, and InsightFace-based face swapping. Runtime is on local hardware with Nvidia GPU (min 4GB VRAM), AMD GPUs via DirectML/ROCm, Apple Silicon via MPS, or CPU-only mode.
title: Fooocus

body: Invoke is a leading creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, empowering professionals, artists, and enthusiasts to generate and create visual media using the latest AI-driven technologies. The solution offers an industry leading WebUI, and serves as the foundation for multiple commercial products.
plain_description: Invoke helps businesses produce professional-grade visual assets using the latest AI image generation models — all running on your own hardware with full commercial rights. No per-seat fees, no cloud dependency, and no license restrictions. The bottom line: your team gets unlimited creative iteration with complete ownership of every output.
technical_description: InvokeAI is a self-hosted AI image generation engine supporting multiple model families including SDXL, SD 3.5, Flux.1/2, CogView 4, Z-Image, Anima, and Qwen Image. It provides a Python backend with a React web UI, featuring a node-based workflow composer for building custom generation pipelines, a unified canvas for inpainting/outpainting, and integrated model management for ckpt, diffusers, and GGUF formats. The runtime includes a board and gallery system for asset organization, upscaling tools, and object segmentation. GPU acceleration is supported on NVIDIA and AMD hardware.
title: InvokeAI

body: Platform built on top of Stable Diffusion WebUI to optimize resource management, speed up inference, and support experimental features like Flux and GGUF models.
plain_description: Generate professional AI images from text descriptions using your own hardware — no cloud subscriptions needed. Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge speeds up image creation and reduces memory usage compared to standard Stable Diffusion WebUI. Run popular models like Flux and SDXL with advanced controls for precise results.
technical_description: Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge is a platform built on AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI and Gradio that provides an optimized runtime for diffusion model inference. It features a GPU memory management system, integrated ControlNet and IP-Adapter support, LoRA loading, and REST API endpoints for txt2img/img2img. The platform supports GGUF-quantized models across multiple diffusion backends including SD1.5, SDXL, SD3, Flux, and Stable Cascade, and provides an extension system for custom pipeline modifications through the Forge UnetPatcher interface.
title: Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge

plain_description: Generate high-quality images from text descriptions with a powerful, easy-to-use web interface. This tool gives you complete control over image creation, from simple prompts to advanced techniques like inpainting, upscaling, and custom model training — all without writing code.
technical_description: Stable Diffusion web UI is a Gradio-based browser interface for Stable Diffusion image generation models. It supports txt2img and img2img pipelines, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling (ESRGAN, SwinIR, LDSR), face restoration (GFPGAN, CodeFormer), and CLIP interrogator. The application runs as a local Python server with a REST API, supports checkpoint merging, LoRA, hypernetworks, Textual Inversion embeddings, and custom script extensions. It operates on NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, Intel, and Ascend NPU hardware via command-line flags.
title: Stable Diffusion web UI
